conversion.basis: Derived by inverting the Unified 60 degree functional-diameter relation δE=1.7321δp in NBS Handbook H28 (1969) Part I section 9, for an ideal 60 degree flank-profile comparator.

conditional_assumptions: Final class dimensions agree with cited reference limits and are confirmed against current ASME B1.1 before physical acceptance use.
At least one mutually engaged full-form thread turn exists outside nut entry/exit chamfers and bolt thread runout.
Nominal single-start helix and ideal 60 degree flank profile; zero pitch/lead, helix-form, flank-angle, taper, and roundness deviations.
No coating or plating outside the final accepted class dimensions.
Relative nut/bolt rotation is restrained during the axial movement considered.
No initial centered phase or preload is assumed.
unresolved_actual_attributes: Current-edition class limit table and selected/delivered thread classes and final profile measurements.
Full-form internal and external engagement coordinates after entry/exit chamfers and thread runout.
Installed axial/rotational phase and initial active flank state.
Rotational restraint, friction, and actual end stops limiting helical travel.

sources.scope: Primary federal Unified thread dimensional limits, 1/4-20 class 2A/2B values, and section 9 functional-diameter/lead-error relation.
Current ASME standard record and scope; numeric tables unavailable in the public preview.
